title: A Jacobson space with finitely many closed points is discrete
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a finite Jacobson space, and more generally a Jacobson space with finitely many closed points, is discrete (author lemma at source lines 3677-3681, label lemma-finite-jacobson). The proof (source lines 3683-3691) shows that the set of closed points is dense by the Jacobson property and closed as a finite union of singletons, hence is the whole space, after which finiteness makes every point open (proof lines 3683-3690). The density-and-closedness argument is the content. H2.
